order: C1 completes400, then C2; one process on physical GPU0, conda hh
data: Original CIFAR100 partition alpha=.3; 100 clients, 10 original slots, seven models, local SGD5epochs batch50; Full-only official evaluation, isolated RNG
initialization: Original fresh seed1 independent seven-profile initialization, NOT continuation from E03 final
c1: Native M2 output only in the intersection of all actual uploads; native AdaptiveFL elsewhere
c2: Same C1/M2 weighted dispatch fusion. Delta=d; reference=original M2 slot-LOO; p=min(dot(d,r/||r||),0)*r/||r||. Intrinsic gate=exp(-4*max(0,-cos)). Learning=sum native n_i/sum(n) * (d_i+(g_i-1)*p_i). No renormalization of projection gates. Native outside intersection.
first_round: C2 preserves C1/M2's weighted dispatch fusion; only actual SGD delta component changes. Never treat independent dispatch differences as SGD deltas.
stopping: 400 complete rounds per candidate; no tuning, extra seeds, methods, or automatic retry. All peaks labelled test-oracle peak.
